susceptibility.name: geonode:flood_susceptibility_class_30m_somalia_adm0
susceptibility.title: Terrain flood susceptibility · 30 m
susceptibility.description: Terrain screening derived from Copernicus DEM GLO-30 using height above nearest drainage, slope, depression depth, flow routing and upstream contributing area. High classes identify locations to inspect. This is not observed flooding, a flood forecast, water depth, a return period or engineering design data.

history.name: geonode:som_flood_prone_areas_merge_of_historical0
history.title: Historical flood footprint · 2013–2023
history.description: Union of SWALIM historical flood extents: Deyr 2023, Gu 2021, Gu/Hagaa 2020, Gu/Deyr 2019, Gu/Deyr 2018, Gu 2016, Gu 2015 and Deyr 2013. Shows where flooding was mapped in those seasons; absence from the footprint does not prove safety, and the layer is not a current flood extent.

breakages.name: geonode:som_river_breakage_shabelle_river_june_2026_frrmsa_short_form
breakages.title: Shabelle bank breakages · August 2026 assessment
breakages.dateLabel: Issued August 2026 · each point carries its imagery date
breakages.description: SWALIM Shabelle riverbank assessment from very high resolution imagery. Point status describes the observation on its imagery date. Remote sensing interpretation has limited field checks. Current condition and repair status need field verification. The August assessment does not cover the Juba River. Points are shown as last mapped; they are not updated when a bank is repaired or breaks again. A few points share one location, so one marker can stand for more than one breakage.
breakages.geometryAuthority: Use GeoJSON geometry coordinates; some source longitude attributes are projected values.

breakagesJuba.name: geonode:river_breakages_juba_shabelle_march2026
breakagesJuba.title: Juba bank breakages · March 2026 assessment
breakagesJuba.dateLabel: Issued March 2026 · each point carries its imagery date
breakagesJuba.description: March 2026 Juba and Shabelle assessment. Filter river=Juba when combined with the newer Shabelle layer to avoid duplicate and older Shabelle points. Observation date is not a current live riverbank status. Points are shown as last mapped; they are not updated when a bank is repaired or breaks again. Many Juba points share a location in the source (one place holds 184 of the 694), so the map shows fewer markers than there are listed breakages.

legendVerification: Colors and class values obtained from public WMS GetStyles version 1.1.1; PNG legends and city-bbox GetMap responses verified on 13 October 2026.
demScreeningLimits: Absolute elevation or a few elevation samples alone cannot determine flood probability, flow direction or safe diversion. Use the official terrain susceptibility layer for screening and commission surveyed cross sections, drainage/culvert and downstream exposure checks with hydrologic/hydraulic analysis before drainage or riverbank works.
